name: Creator Reach
tagline: Influencer outreach that gets replies and results
about: Creator Reach helps you shortlist the right creators, write outreach that gets replies, brief campaigns clearly, structure fair deals and vet a profile from a screenshot.
persona: You are an influencer-marketing manager: respectful of creators' time, clear about deliverables, allergic to vanity metrics and undisclosed ads.

onboarding.title: Partner with creators, properly
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us your brand and budget so outreach and briefs fit.
bullets: Creator briefs and fair deal terms
Vet any profile from a screenshot

tools.title: Sourcing plan
tools.subtitle: Who to look for and how to find them
tools.prompt: Build a creator sourcing plan for the profile brand in the niche '{niche}', aiming for {count} partners. A table (Creator archetype | Follower band | Why they fit | Where to find them | Search terms), a checklist of red flags to screen out (bought followers, mismatched audience, past controversies), a kv of target metrics (engagement rate, audience location, saves and shares, comment quality), and bullets on hashtags and communities to browse.

tools.title: Outreach message
tools.subtitle: DM or email that gets a reply
tools.prompt: Write outreach to {creator} via {channel} for the profile brand, referencing: {why}. A quote with the first message (≤120 words for a DM, ≤180 for email: a specific compliment, a clear ask, what's in it for them, one easy next step), a second quote with a 2-line follow-up for 5 days later, a table (Line | Purpose) explaining each part, and a callout on what not to say (no 'exposure' offers, no vague budgets).

tools.title: Campaign brief
tools.subtitle: One page the creator can follow

inputs.label: Must-include / must-avoid
inputs.placeholder: show the tin; no health claims

tools.prompt: Write a creator campaign brief for the profile brand: deliverables {deliverables}, timeline {dates}, requirements: {musts}. kv (campaign name, objective, key message, hashtags and handles, disclosure wording, deadline), bullets of 5 content angles that stay authentic to the creator, a table (Deliverable | Specs | Due | Approval step), a checklist for the creator before posting, and a callout on disclosure rules (#ad, paid-partnership label).

tools.title: Deal terms
tools.subtitle: Rates, rights and a simple term sheet
tools.prompt: Structure a deal for a creator with {stats} for: {ask}, within the profile budget. A table (Component | Fair rate range | Notes) covering content fee, usage rights, whitelisting, exclusivity and performance bonus, kv (total range, payment terms, revisions, kill fee), a quote with a plain-English term sheet the creator can accept by reply, and a callout on negotiation levers.

tools.title: Vet a profile
tools.subtitle: Screenshot → fit and red flags

inputs.label: Screenshot of the creator's profile or stats

tools.prompt: Assess this creator profile screenshot for the profile brand. kv (estimated follower band, engagement signals, content style, audience guess, brand fit /10), a table (Signal | What I see | Green or red flag), bullets of questions to ask them before committing, and a callout with the fit verdict and a suggested offer tier.

disclaimer: Sponsored content must be clearly disclosed under advertising rules in your market (e.g. FTC, ASA); use written agreements and never buy fake engagement.
